user.title: Connect to Moonlight
user.description: Enter where the Moonlight add-on (or server) is running. Inside Home Assistant OS the add-on is usually reachable as `{addon_host}` (installed from a local add-on folder) or via your Home Assistant host's IP address, on port {port}.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of Moonlight, e.g. local-moonlight or 192.168.1.20.
Hostname or IP address of Moonlight.

pair.title: Pair Home Assistant with Moonlight

reauth_confirm.title: Pair Home Assistant with Moonlight again
reauth_confirm.description: Moonlight at `{host}` no longer accepts Home Assistant (pairing was turned on, or Home Assistant was revoked under Settings > Screens). Select **Submit** to get a new pairing code.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't connect. Check the host and port, and that the add-on is running.
error.not_moonlight: Something answered, but it doesn't look like Moonlight.
error.not_paired: That code hasn't been entered in Moonlight yet. Enter it under Settings > Screens > Pair a new screen, then select Submit again.
error.pair_expired: The code expired; here is a new one.
error.pair_busy: Too many screens are waiting to pair with Moonlight. Try again in a few minutes.
error.pair_failed: Moonlight couldn't start pairing. Make sure the add-on is up to date.

abort.already_configured: This Moonlight is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Home Assistant is paired with Moonlight again.
